items.title: John E. Wood Interview, 1986-06-26
items.q: And last time, I also bought the Kid Thomas record that has Sammy Remington on it

ctx.x: Yeah. Well, that narrows it down. Yeah.

And, in fact, when my daughter was here earlier this week, we did go down to Preservation Hall one night, and there was one copy of that record still in the back bin, and I bought it to replace my warped one, and I bought them. That one, the Brunius one down there, too. And last time, I also bought the Kid Thomas record that has Sammy Remington on it, which Kid Thomas plays Red Wing. I bought it because I like that number, and I thought it's... Who is Sammy Remington? Yeah, he appears. I see his name on all these…
Yeah, and he plays clarinet, usually. And he sounds a lot like George Lewis as a way of characterizing it.
